Morgan L: 15 mins until all-hands. Quick audio check  I'm hearing a subtle echo on the stream preview, anyone else?
Casey (AV): hear a tiny echo in cam-1 feed. retesting jack/loopback now.
Jin R: deck synced, slides auto-advance enabled. good to go from design.
Casey (AV): echo was a live-monitor loopback. muted local monitor; echo gone. switching recorder to multi-track so we can export separate mic + room audio.
Morgan L: nice. can we also cut a separate Q&A track for social clips?
Casey (AV): yes. starting ffmpeg capture to split tracks. command: ```
ffmpeg -f alsa -i hw:0 -map 0:a:0 -c copy host_mic.wav -map 0:a:1 -c copy room_mix.wav
```
Nora S: Heads-up: captions drifted ~0.7s last time. If we go multi-track, can you route clean audio to transcriber? less drift that way.
Casey (AV): will route clean feed to transcriber-lowlatency. expect slight drop in WER but latency down.
Kieran (CEO): If it's lowlatency and readable, go for it. Also: can we add +7 mins at the end for live Qs?
Morgan L: +7 minutes noted. Priya asked earlier for +5, so +7 covers follow-ups.
Deploy-bot: Reminder: scheduled canary rollout to console at 14:00 UTC. (paused)
Morgan L: please keep it paused till after the all-hands. no rollouts during meeting unless P0.
Nora S: One more: OBS window capture sometimes crops the slide footer. Casey, can you lock crop to maintain captions visible?
Casey (AV): locked window crop, captions track pinned above video.
Ops-bot: Recording started by Casey (AV)  meeting_id=ah-2026-06-12-2387654321
Morgan L: great. if any hiccups ping here. we'll log follow-up Qs in #product after the meeting for answers.
Jin R: will drop post-its for action items.
Casey (AV): clip markers set: qa-clip-start=2387654355, qa-clip-end=2387654389. will export stemmed audio + isolated Q&A video.
Kieran (CEO): thanks team. see you on stage in 10. :rocket:
